title: Photography Tiers
slide_intent: Teach designers to choose the photographic approach that fits the communication’s job. A food scene and an isolated catalog product answer different viewer questions.
strategic_value: Instacart can organize its photographic range by purpose while retaining a coherent image direction across applications.
demonstration: Four similarly sized circular photographs introduce food-focused, lifestyle, product spotlight and catalogue images in a single row.
practical_value: Decide whether the viewer needs appetite, context, a product hero or item identification, then use the corresponding tier for the brief.

content_islands.name: Tier examples
content_islands.spec: Place the four circular crops at equal intervals across the white page: a food scene, people outdoors, a product spotlight and an isolated jar.

content_islands.name: Tier names
content_islands.spec: Center a concise label beneath every photograph and keep their order aligned with the examples.
